commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
if [ -f /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg ]; then
  echo FILE=/etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    key="${line%%=*}"
    case "$key" in
      *password*|*passwd*|*secret*|*key*|*token*|*cert_|*priv*|HostKeyFile*|SshKeyFile*|ssh_*priv*|allowed*|admin*|forward_*|permit*|permitroot*|passwordauthentication|*auth*|whitelist*|permit*)
        echo "REDACTED_LINE=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -E 's/^.{0,120}/[REDACTED]/')"
        ;;
      *)
        printf '%s\n' "$line"
        ;;
    esac
  done < /etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg
else
  echo FILE_MISSING=/etc/ragin/cowrie.cfg
fi
echo DONE
